conventions.frames: 1-based; loops repeat their first key as the last key (keep it, UE loops seamlessly)
conventions.car_forward: nose points +Y in mesh space; the car always drives BACKWARDS, so rotate the mesh component Yaw 90 so the tail points along the actor's +X (verify with the arrow)
conventions.car_left_right: L/R = the direction the car's path bends, seen in the direction of travel
conventions.rider_direction: _B/_L/_R = where the player is relative to the rider (behind/left/right); for Damage/Death it is where the hit comes from

rider_socket.note: bone points up; create a Skeleton Socket on it rotated 90 deg so the rider sits upright facing the camel's head (check with a Preview Asset)
